context.transcript:
Good afternoon, Ms. Alamry.
I'm calling from the Warlington Film Office.
The city has accepted your application for a permit to film here.
Since you need some streets to be closed while you're making your movie, you now need to submit a traffic control plan for approval.
Given how soon you aim to film, I recommend using the online portal.
You'll just need to set up a username and password.
It gets processed much faster than mail.
If you have any questions, call me at 555-0199.
context.transcript_translation:
下午好，Alamry女士。
我是从Warlington电影办公室打来的电话。
市政府已经接受了您在这里拍摄的许可证申请。
由于您在制作电影时需要关闭一些街道，现在您需要提交一份交通控制计划以获得批准。
考虑到您打算拍摄的时间很近，我建议使用在线门户网站。
您只需要设置一个用户名和密码。
这样处理比邮寄快得多。
如果您有任何问题，请拨打我的电话555-0199。
